name: Maximum-Generated Classes Are Closed under Cube Complement
statement: The complement of a maximum-generated class in its specified visible cube is maximum-generated, allowing the empty class as a boundary object.
proof: Complement a proper maximum parent in its whole cube and reverse membership on the fixed visible face. The complement of a rank-$r$ maximum class on $N$ coordinates is maximum of rank $N-r-1$, and its marked section is the visible cube complement.
